component.name: Comilito
component.summary: Soundboard and mixer for tabletop role-playing games

description.p: Comilito lets a game master build a library of sounds for a campaign and play them live at the table, for Dungeons & Dragons, Pathfinder, Call of Cthulhu and other tabletop role-playing games.

ul.li: Music: background tracks, one at a time, with crossfades
Ambience: looping layers such as rain, tavern chatter or wind, stacked together
Effects: one-shot sounds such as a door slam or a dragon's roar

description.p: Scenes gather music, ambience and effects. Stack scenes to build up a moment: higher scenes quiet the ambience below them, and the top one decides the music. Hotkeys, presets and a mini player keep it quick to use during a session. Scenes can also show videos on a second screen.
Each campaign is a plain folder with its own audio files, easy to back up, sync or share as a single file.
